# Markdown links

Seed links for the index. Each one should become suggestible after `[`.

- [Obsidian developer docs](https://docs.obsidian.md/Home)
- [Obsidian API typings](https://github.com/obsidianmd/obsidian-api/blob/master/obsidian.d.ts)
- [Docs](https://docs.obsidian.md/Home) and [Docs](https://help.obsidian.md/) — same text, two URLs
- [Foo (disambiguation)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Foo_(bar)) — parentheses in the URL
- [Spaced](<https://example.com/a path>) — angle-bracket destination
- [Titled](https://example.com/titled "A title") — link title
- [https://example.com/self](https://example.com/self) — text is the URL; indexed like any other

## Must not be indexed

- `[In code](https://example.com/code)`
- ![Image](https://example.com/image.png)
- [[Wikilink]]
- [Internal](Some%20note.md)
- <https://example.com/autolink>

```
[In a code block](https://example.com/block)
```
